in_marathi.name: Chaanakya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chaanakya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chaanakya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chanana’, meaning 'wise' or 'intelligent'. He is known as Kautilya or Vishnugupta in various Indian texts. Chaanakya is famous for his role as a prime minister and chief advisor to the powerful emperor Chandragupta Maurya. He is also revered for his wisdom and knowledge in various areas including economics, warfare, and politics.
